title: Unraveling the Complexities in TNBC Gene Interaction Networks Towards Better Therapeutics.
authors: Paranthaman, Priyanga; Krishnamoorthy, HemaNandini Rajendran; Veluchamy, Selvakumar; Karuppasamy, Ramanathan; Veerappapillai, Shanthi
one_liner_zh: 该文基于PPI网络分析TNBC枢纽蛋白并做药物重定位，含分子对接与MM-GBSA，但核心是蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) presents a substantial global health challenge due to its highly aggressive and invasive traits. To address this, the present study employed network-based analysis using protein-protein interaction (PPI) data to identify hub proteins and their functional insights. We constructed a PPI network consisting of 1413 dysregulated genes in TNBC. These hub genes displayed 5763 interactions. The downstream analysis identified TP53, SRC, EP300, AKT1, HSP90AA1, MAPK3, EGFR, and SMAD3 as hub proteins based on topological parameters and functional enrichment analyses. The DGIdb data were exploited to investigate the link between drugs and the identified hub genes. Collectively, the findings showed that no Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-approved drugs exist to target the EP300 protein. This situation necessitates the discovery of potential repurposed candidate against EP300 protein from the repository of 2147 FDA-approved compounds. Precisely, molecular docking, MM-GBSA, and ML-based rescoring analysis identified DB06137 (tirbanibulin) as a lead compound. Moreover, the dynamic behavior of DB06137 reinforces its exceptional structural stability with EP300, indicating its potential for novel therapeutic applications. We hypothesize that tirbanibulin interacts either with the regulatory regions of EP300 through allosteric inhibition or indirectly by altering upstream signaling pathways. Given the vital role of drug repurposing, experimental investigations on tirbanibulin unanticipated effects against EP300 are an interesting future direction.
abstract_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）因其高度侵袭性和浸润性特征，构成了全球性的重大健康挑战。为应对此问题，本研究采用基于蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）数据的网络分析，以识别核心蛋白及其功能见解。我们构建了一个包含1413个在TNBC中失调基因的PPI网络，这些核心基因展示了5763种相互作用。下游分析基于拓扑参数和功能富集分析，确定了TP53、SRC、EP300、AKT1、HSP90AA1、MAPK3、EGFR和SMAD3为核心蛋白。利用DGIdb数据探讨了药物与已识别核心基因之间的关联。总体而言，研究结果显示，目前尚无美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准的药物靶向EP300蛋白。这一现状促使我们从2147种FDA批准的化合物库中寻找针对EP300蛋白的潜在重定位候选药物。具体而言，分子对接、MM-GBSA及基于机器学习的重打分分析确定了DB06137（tirbanibulin）为先导化合物。此外，DB06137的动态行为强化了其与EP300的卓越结构稳定性，表明其具有新型治疗应用的潜力。我们假设tirbanibulin通过与EP300的调控区域发生变构抑制，或间接改变上游信号通路来发挥作用。鉴于药物重定位的关键作用，对tirbanibulin针对EP300的意外效应进行实验研究是未来一个有趣的方向。
